principle: Ship Infinity with a completely static field of subtle Brandon Grotesque Bold digits behind the fixed subject. Preserve the accepted IBK-001 density, size, and #edeae3 on #f7f5ef palette. Derive a deterministic digit arrangement from portrait identity so every Infinity portrait is unique without adding background motion.

recipes.name: Static portrait-unique number field
recipes.description: A completely still 13-by-21 field of subtle single digits. Portrait identity determines which digits occupy the fixed grid, giving every Infinity video a unique but visually consistent background.
